editorial.title_zh: 英国公布CBAM原产地豁免草案，拟立法后追溯至2027年1月1日
editorial.title_en: UK publishes draft origin exemptions from CBAM with intended retrospective effect from 1 January 2027
editorial.summary_zh: 11月23日，英国税务海关总署发布草案全文，落实11月20日峰会公布的政策意向。欧盟、欧洲经济区和瑞士原产的范围内货物拟按英国非优惠原产地规则免征英国CBAM，不计入5万英镑注册门槛，且无需列入英国CBAM申报表。草案预计在2027年1月1日后获御准，届时拟追溯适用于自该日起进口的合格货物。草案另拟赋权财政部按条件对其他合格ETS互联国家或地区的指定商品设置豁免。法案通过前，进口商需遵守届时有效的法律和留档要求。
editorial.summary_en: HMRC published draft text on 23 November, following the 20 November summit. Covered goods of EU, EEA or Swiss non-preferential origin would incur no UK CBAM and be omitted from the GBP 50,000 registration test and the UK CBAM return. Royal Assent is expected after 1 January 2027, with retrospective application once enacted. Importers are to keep appropriate records and comply with the rules in force.
editorial.impact_zh: 对2027年英国热轧、冷轧、镀层板及其他纳入范围的钢材订单，先按商品编码及非优惠原产地识别货物。中国原产钢材经欧盟仓储或转运后，其英国CBAM成本仍按适用规则计入报价。与进口商确认税费承担、原产地和排放资料留存，并将欧洲供应商可能取得的豁免计入竞争报价情景。
editorial.impact_en: For 2027 UK HRC, CRC and coated products, check the commodity code and non-preferential origin. Continue allowing for UK CBAM on in-scope China-origin material shipped via European stock or transit. Agree importer records and cost allocation and evaluate eligible European offers under a separate exemption scenario.
editorial.coverage: 核对草案第1条第(1)至(3)及(10)款、政府说明中的御准及追溯安排，以及HMRC原产地指引。政府说明：https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/draft-legislation-exemption-for-eu-eea-and-swiss-origin-goods-from-cbam。公告未给出御准的确定日期。

editorial.title_zh: 美国对韩国冷轧板2024年度反补贴复审初裁：现代制铁0.66%，浦项1.10%
editorial.title_en: US 2024 Korean cold-rolled steel CVD review preliminarily sets Hyundai Steel at 0.66% and POSCO at 1.10%
editorial.summary_zh: 美国商务部11月23日公布C-580-882初裁，复审期为2024年1月1日至12月31日。现代制铁0.66%，浦项钢铁1.10%；上一年度复审终裁分别为1.28%和3.64%。46家附件II企业因申请撤回终止复审，另有KG Dongbu因复审期无可复审的暂停清算进口记录终止复审，相关清算以进口时保证金率为准。原令涉及韩国特定冷轧碳钢及合金钢板材，HTSUS包括7209.15.0000、7209.16.0030及部分7211.23、7225.50子目，具体适用以书面范围为准；排除项包括轴承钢、工具钢、硅锰钢和取向电工钢。听证申请应于公布后30日内在美东时间17:00前提交，案情陈述以最后一份核查报告出具后7日为限，反驳陈述再有5日。除非延期，拟在初裁公布后120日内出终裁。
editorial.summary_en: Commerce's 23 November preliminary results for C-580-882 (2024 review period) are 0.66% for Hyundai Steel and 1.10% for POSCO, versus 1.28% and 3.64% in the prior final review. It rescinded for 46 Appendix II firms after withdrawals, and for KG Dongbu due to no reviewable suspended entries. Scope is governed by the written order. Hearing requests are due within 30 days at 5 p.m. ET, and case briefs seven days after the last verification report.
editorial.impact_zh: 先以现行美国海关保证金指令核算韩国同类冷轧板报价；初裁数字仅用于竞争情景。终裁若维持，浦项货源成本变化幅度会大于现代制铁。比价时分开核对企业、产品和其他适用的美国进口税费。中国原产货物仍按其各自适用措施报价。
editorial.impact_en: Use current US deposit instructions for quotes. If the preliminary rates are retained at final, POSCO would see the greater potential cost change. Compare like grades and producers while applying other US duties and the separate measures on China-origin goods.
editorial.coverage: 核对11月23日联邦公报税率表、撤回复审附件II、KG Dongbu单独段落、提交期限、原征税令附件及2023年度终裁；初裁尚未形成新的现行保证金指令。原令：https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2016-22614；此前终裁：https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-17768。

editorial.title_zh: 英国CBAM注册指南更新：区分拟豁免原产货物与经欧洲转运的第三国货物
editorial.title_en: UK CBAM threshold guidance distinguishes eligible origin from transit through Europe
editorial.summary_zh: HMRC 11月23日更新5万英镑注册门槛操作指引。按同日草案，欧盟、欧洲经济区或瑞士原产的合格货物拟排除在门槛之外；经这些地区转运、原产地仍为第三国且无其他排除情形的货物计入。原产地按英国非优惠规则认定，进口商对范围内货物保留记录。
editorial.summary_en: On 23 November HMRC clarified how the planned exemption affects the GBP 50,000 registration threshold. Eligible EU, EEA and Swiss-origin goods would be omitted; third-country covered goods routed through these markets count unless a separate exclusion applies. The draft remains subject to enactment.
editorial.impact_zh: 把英国进口商的门槛测算与货物路线区分开。中国冷轧、镀锌等在范围内的钢材走欧洲仓或港口出运时，应向进口商提供正确原产地和报关资料，按其合计进口额核算门槛及成本。
editorial.impact_en: Model the threshold by importer and goods origin. Provide correct origin and declaration data for in-scope China-origin CRC or galvanized steel moving via a European port or warehouse.
editorial.coverage: 核对HMRC注册门槛指引11月23日新增段落，并用同日草案政府说明确认立法前后适用条件。

editorial.title_zh: 英国CBAM留档指引更新：拟获原产地豁免的进口货物仍需保存证明
editorial.title_en: UK CBAM recordkeeping update requires origin evidence for goods expected to qualify for exemption
editorial.summary_zh: 11月23日HMRC新增欧盟、欧洲经济区及瑞士原产货物留档说明。即使进口货物预计适用豁免，仍应保留其原产地记录；经上述地区转运不能单凭路径获得豁免。按现行实施安排，从2027年1月1日起保存进口记录，2028年1月1日开放注册。
editorial.summary_en: HMRC added a section on evidence of EU, EEA and Swiss origin on 23 November. Keep origin records for goods expected to be exempt. Transit alone does not confer the exemption. Recordkeeping starts on 1 January 2027 and registration opens on 1 January 2028.
editorial.impact_zh: 与英国进口商确认2027年订单交付的资料，包括支持原产地的生产和商业单据，以及范围内进口的海关文件、净重和适用的排放资料。拟享豁免的竞争供应也需要原产地证据。
editorial.impact_en: Agree which production, commercial, customs, weight and applicable emissions records the UK importer will retain. Potentially exempt competing supply also needs origin evidence.
editorial.coverage: 核对11月23日更新说明、拟豁免货物留档章节及2027/2028实施日期。

editorial.title_zh: 英国ETS总览更新欧英互联后的五项征询安排
editorial.title_en: UK ETS overview updates the handling of five consultations following the EU link agreement
editorial.summary_zh: 11月23日，英国ETS政策总览说明，11月20日公布的欧英互联协议已处理五项征询的政策结果，涉及制氢免费配额、可持续航空燃料、二氧化碳非管道运输、国际海运纳入和航空免费配额结束对区域连通性的影响。主管机构将分别发布反馈摘要。跨境碳捕集与封存管道征询仍拟单独发布完整回复。本次更新着重于征询处理安排。
editorial.summary_en: The 23 November overview update explains how the 20 November ETS linking agreement addresses five consultations spanning hydrogen allocation, sustainable aviation fuel, non-pipeline CO2 transport, international maritime coverage and regional aviation connectivity. Summaries are due later; the cross-boundary CCS pipelines consultation will receive a full response.
editorial.impact_zh: 欧英互联的后续立法和钢铁免费配额安排仍值得跟踪。英国钢材报价继续采用进口期适用的英国CBAM参数，并在航运合同实际出现ETS费用时单独核实分摊。
editorial.impact_en: Track linking implementation and steel free-allocation rules. Continue using UK CBAM parameters applicable to the import period and verify any maritime ETS charges separately under the freight contract.
editorial.coverage: 核对GOV.UK更新日志及政策全文五项征询段落。

editorial.title_zh: 22家欧洲工业企业要求稳定ETS与CBAM，签署方称低碳投资计划逾380亿欧元
editorial.title_en: 22 European industrial firms seek predictable ETS and effective CBAM, citing over EUR 38 billion in low-carbon investments
editorial.summary_zh: Cleantech for Europe发布11月19日公开信。22家钢铁、水泥、化工等企业负责人称，其已决定或等待最终投资决定的低碳项目超过380亿欧元。签署方要求保持有效碳价、覆盖受管产品价值链并防止规避，同时改善低碳产品需求和电力成本。投资额由签署方披露，包含未作最终投资决定的项目。
editorial.summary_en: In a 19 November open letter, leaders of 22 industrial companies said that more than EUR 38 billion in low-carbon investment had been decided or was awaiting final investment decision. They called for predictable pricing, broader value-chain coverage and anti-circumvention under CBAM, plus demand support and competitive electricity.
editorial.impact_zh: 对欧低碳钢和下游加工件合同可以跟踪欧盟CBAM扩围及客户低碳采购标准的变化。公开信反映行业诉求，签约成本仍按已适用的产品范围和进口期参数核算。
editorial.impact_en: Track the downstream CBAM file and buyers' low-emissions procurement standards. Apply enacted scope and import-period values to contracts.
editorial.coverage: 核对签署方公开信原文、日期、投资口径及三组诉求；未将企业披露当作政府统计。

editorial.title_zh: 力拓周报回顾对华铁矿供应协议，矿种采购条件仍需逐项核实
editorial.title_en: Rio Tinto weekly recap revisits China iron ore deal, with product-level purchasing terms unconfirmed
editorial.summary_zh: TradingView 11月23日周报回顾称，力拓和中国矿产资源集团已就铁矿石供应达成协议，并提及此前部分矿种的采购限制。路透10月报道援引知情人士证实达成新供应合同，11月18日报道称采购磋商仍受关注。周报题中4号线指新西兰蒂瓦伊角的铝冶炼电解线。具体矿种、合同条款以及此前限制当前是否仍适用，缺少双方正式文件。
editorial.summary_en: TradingView's 23 November recap repeats reporting on an iron ore supply deal between Rio Tinto and China's CMRG and earlier product-level curbs. October Reuters reporting cites sources on the deal. The Line 4 item concerns the Tiwai Point aluminium smelter. Current mineral-specific restrictions and commercial terms were not independently confirmed.
editorial.impact_zh: 采购端可按矿种跟踪合同资源、现货替代和价差。成材报价暂用自身现行原料成本，待确认采购条件变化后再修正成本假设。
editorial.impact_en: Track term availability, spot substitutes and spreads by iron ore product. Change finished-steel cost assumptions only when actual procurement conditions change.
editorial.coverage: 核对周报全文及路透10月21日、11月18日报道；研判限于公开报道所述，未核实企业合同、限制清单或吨位。

editorial.title_zh: 航运业估算：几内亚10月铁矿石海运出口逾500万吨，单月全球第三
editorial.title_en: BIMCO estimate puts Guinea third in seaborne iron ore exports in October at more than 5 Mt
editorial.summary_zh: 航运媒体引述BIMCO估算，2026年10月几内亚铁矿石出口超过500万吨，约占当月全球海运铁矿量3%，单月排名第三，年内累计逾2200万吨，主要流向中国。力拓项目资料确认西芒杜首船于2025年12月离港，两个项目共用铁路及港口设计出口能力为每年最多1.2亿吨。单月航运排名、累计发运和设计产能为不同口径。
editorial.summary_en: BIMCO estimates Guinea shipped more than 5 Mt in October, around 3% of global seaborne iron ore that month, ranking third; reported 2026 shipments to date exceeded 22 Mt and went mainly to China. Rio Tinto confirms first shipment in December 2025 and shared rail and port design export capacity of up to 120 Mt per year.
editorial.impact_zh: 高品位进口矿来源增加对配矿和运费有潜在影响。关注中国到港量、品位溢价和几内亚至中国海运费，用实际到岸成本检验对高炉原料成本的影响。
editorial.impact_en: Track actual arrivals in China, grade premiums and freight from Guinea before revising blast-furnace feed cost assumptions.
editorial.coverage: 核对报道日期、BIMCO的当月海运统计及力拓项目页（https://www.riotinto.com/operations/africa/simandou）；全球排名为BIMCO口径，未获得官方全年海关排名。

editorial.title_zh: 行业转引统计局数据：中国1—10月铁矿石原矿产量7.33亿吨，同比降11.7%
editorial.title_en: Industry reports citing China's statistics bureau put Jan–Oct raw iron ore output at 733 Mt, down 11.7%
editorial.summary_zh: IndexBox 11月20日报道引述SteelOrbis和中国国家统计局数据，2026年前十个月国内铁矿石产量约7.33亿吨，同比降11.7%。我的钢铁网转引统计局细分数据为73308.4万吨，10月6167.2万吨，同比降25.2%。这里为铁矿石原矿产量口径。
editorial.summary_en: IndexBox cites SteelOrbis and China's statistics bureau for about 733 Mt of domestic raw iron ore output in January–October 2026, down 11.7%. Mysteel cites 733.084 Mt and October output of 61.672 Mt, down 25.2% year on year.
editorial.impact_zh: 判断热卷、板坯原料成本时，应同时看进口铁矿的到港量、港口库存、品位差价和高炉开工。原矿产量不能直接用于计算进口商品矿缺口。
editorial.impact_en: Assess HRC and slab feed costs alongside imported ore arrivals, stocks, grade spreads and furnace utilisation. Raw ore tonnage cannot quantify the shortfall in imported usable ore.
editorial.coverage: 核对IndexBox全文及我的钢铁网所载统计明细（https://m.mysteel.com/a/26111812/E37D637177491C00_abc.html）。未从国家统计局取得同口径的可读原表，按行业转引记录。

editorial.title_zh: deVere研判2027年欧美与亚洲钢价或进一步分化
editorial.title_en: deVere expects possible 2027 steel-price divergence between protected Western markets and Asia
editorial.summary_zh: deVere于11月19日发表市场分析，认为亚洲产能压力与欧美贸易壁垒可能扩大钢价地区差，英国钢价还受配额和需求共同影响。文章为机构情景，未形成逐市场、逐钢种的成交价格指引。涉及欧盟冷轧反倾销的陈述应以实施条例EU 2026/2547为准。
editorial.summary_en: deVere's 19 November commentary discusses possible price divergence in 2027 as Asian capacity pressures persist and Western trade barriers tighten. It is a market scenario. EU cold-rolled anti-dumping details should be taken from Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2547.
editorial.impact_zh: 2027年热轧、冷轧及镀层钢报价可安排分市场敏感性测算，按目的地实际配额、税率、碳成本和当地成交价复算。预测本身暂不触发调整未成交报价。
editorial.impact_en: Build HRC, CRC and coated price scenarios by destination. Recalculate against actual quotas, duties, carbon costs and local transaction prices before adjusting quotes.
editorial.coverage: 核对deVere原文及欧盟实施条例EU 2026/2547，记录机构展望，不以媒体表述代替法规。

editorial.title_zh: 欧盟CBAM下游扩围仍在谈判，光伏企业须按现行税号和50吨门槛核算
editorial.title_en: EU downstream CBAM expansion is still under negotiation; current customs scope and 50 tonne threshold remain applicable
editorial.summary_zh: 本轮定位到10月21日煤炭资源网全文。欧洲议会程序档案确认，9月15日议会通过扩围修正案并将案卷交回主管委员会进入机构间谈判；理事会11月20日议程为三方谈判作准备。现行简化条例EU 2025/2083附件VII规定钢铁等适用行业按进口商计算的单一年度净重门槛为50吨。报道将光伏组件、跟踪器及支架和5吨门槛写入同一叙事；本轮取得的欧盟官方材料支持程序进度，未发现已生效的最终光伏CN清单或一般5吨门槛。
editorial.summary_en: The source article is now readable. The Parliament file records the 15 September amendments and referral back for negotiations, and the Council agenda records trilogue preparations. Under Regulation (EU) 2025/2083, the applicable annual net mass threshold is 50 tonnes. The media claims do not establish an enacted PV code list or a general five-tonne threshold.
editorial.impact_zh: 对欧钢制支架、跟踪器及光伏零部件，先逐商品核对已生效CBAM附件和进口商累计吨数。与客户区分钢卷、单独钢结构件及整套设备的税号，留存前体钢材排放资料，待正式公布后再更新下游品种报价和合同适用范围。
editorial.impact_en: Check enacted CN scope and aggregated importer volumes separately for steel coil inputs, standalone steel structures and complete systems. Preserve precursor emissions records and revisit the scope and pricing once a final act is published.
